title: The Stasis Lantern
description: A mystical wooden shop called The Stasis Lantern stands at night under a swirling, aurora-filled sky. A hooded figure in blue robes stands in the open doorway reaching toward shelves of glowing blue potions and lanterns, while an open illuminated book, scrolls, scales, and hanging lanterns rest on a wooden table in the foreground.
prompt: A mysterious wooden fantasy shop named The Stasis Lantern at night, blue and white striped awning, glowing blue potions and lanterns hanging from the exterior, a hooded wizard in deep blue robes standing in the doorway reaching for a shelf, large open illuminated book with glowing symbols on a wooden table in foreground, scrolls, scales and candlelight, dramatic swirling aurora borealis in the dark sky, barren landscape in distance, atmospheric fantasy illustration
